A clean, flat textbook illustration of a white Zebu cow (White Fulani breed) in profile. The cow has long lyre-shaped horns, a prominent muscular hump on its back behind the neck, a large fleshy dewlap hanging under the neck and brisket, a barrel-shaped body, four legs with cloven hooves, an udder with four teats between the hind legs, and a long tail ending in a hairy switch. White background.

Split illustration comparing the head and tail of a sheep and a goat. On the left, a sheep (Yankasa breed) with drooping ears, a downward-hanging tail, and no beard. On the right, a goat (Red Sokoto breed) with erect ears pointing slightly forward, a distinct beard under the chin, two small wattles on the neck, and a short tail pointing upwards.

A side profile of a Large White pig. It has a long snout with a flat rooting disc at the tip, erect ears pointing upwards, a very short neck, a long, heavy barrel-shaped white body covered with sparse short bristles, short legs showing two main hooves and two smaller dewclaws higher up, and a short curled tail.

A New Zealand White rabbit in a resting, slightly crouched posture. It has a thick white fur coat, very long erect ears (pinnae) showing pink insides, large pink eyes, a split upper lip showing prominent front teeth, short front legs, large folded muscular hind legs, and a small fluffy tail ball.

A mature Rhode Island Red cockerel standing upright. The head features a sharp beak, a prominent zigzag red comb on top, and large red wattles hanging below. The body is covered in glossy brown/red feathers, with folded wings on the side. The legs are scaly and featherless, ending in toes with claws, and a sharp spur points backward from the shank.
